title: Test the named-root refusal remedy's own changed-token fence in the post-read window
outcome: A test changes the reporting session's routing token after the refusal handler's authority read has validated it and before engram_named_root_refusal_remedy_locked takes the state lock. It asserts that nothing is flagged and that the 409 says the binding changed while the naming was in flight. The test-model refusal callback documents its lock order (named-roots model mutex, then the state lock) or runs after the model lock is released.
acceptance: a test exercises engram_named_root_refusal_remedy_locked's token-not-held branch through a hook in the window between the authority read's post-check and the remedy's lock, asserting no flag and the 'binding changed while this naming was in flight' message
on_inactive_refusal in src/engram_named_root_test_transport.rs documents its lock order or runs outside the model lock
the change is reviewed and gated under the standing rule
